shortDescription: Resource module for Wireless Controllers Provision

options.name: apAuthorizationListName
options.description: AP Authorization List name. Obtain the names using API call GET /intent/api/v1/wirelessSettings/apAuthorizationLists. During re-provision, obtain the AP Authorization List configured for the given provisioned network device Id.

options.name: authorizeMeshAndNonMeshAccessPoints
options.description: true if AP Authorization List should authorize against All Mesh/Non-Mesh APs, else false if AP Authorization List should only authorize against Mesh APs (Applicable only when Mesh is enabled on sites).

options.name: catalystcenter_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: catalystcenter_password
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center password to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_username
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center username to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: catalystcenter_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco Catalyst Center to use.

options.name: deviceId
options.description: DeviceId path parameter. Network Device ID. This value can be obtained by using the API call GET /dna/intent/api/v1/network-device/ip-address/${ipAddress}.

options.name: lscPercentage
options.description: Permissible values are 5, 15, and 25. This represents the percentage of access points that can be affected due to certificate renewal execution in the current iteration. This field is applicable only when the selected LSC profile is of staggered execution type.

options.name: lscProfileName
options.description: Obtain the LSC profile names by using the API call GET /dna/intent/api/v1/wirelessSettings/lscRene...

options.name: skipApProvision
options.description: true if Skip AP Provision is enabled, else False.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
